def find_arithmetic_sequence(N, a):
    # Sort the array to find the common difference easily
    a_sorted = sorted(a)
    # Check if the array is already an arithmetic sequence
    if N <= 2 or a_sorted[1] - a_sorted[0] == a_sorted[-1] - a_sorted[-2]:
        return a
    # Try to find the position where the change could be made
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(i + 1, N):
            # Calculate the common difference
            d = (a[j] - a[i]) / (j - i)
            b = [a[i] + d * (k - i) for k in range(N)]
            if b != a and all(b[k] == a[k] or b[k] == a[j] for k in range(N)):
                return b

def main():
    T = int(input())
    for _ in range(T):
        N = int(input())
        a = list(map(int, input().split()))
        result = find_arithmetic_sequence(N, a)
        print(*result)
